summary: T1 item 8 (characterization report): docs/characterization-report.md exists, is current (every cited spec-row evidence record content-pinned in its staleness table), and aggregates every ratified spec row across the 45-corner PVT matrix with the evidence record each verdict rests on, recording FAIL rows as FAIL rather than hiding them. 'status: pass' here asserts the artifact's existence, currency and completeness -- it is the characterization item's own verdict, not a claim that every spec row passes (4 of 9 electrical rows fail at some corners; the report says exactly which and why). The envelope binds the report by repo path and content hash: signoff/check.py fails when the report changes without a re-pin (python3 signoff/check.py --regen), and the re-rendered signoff report discloses whether the pin still verified.
